options_evaluated: Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) Polycarbonate (PC) with internal ribbing
Bio-based Polylactic Acid (PLA) composite with flax fiber reinforcement
decisions.trade_off: Balancing mechanical impact resistance and drop durability (extending product lifetime) against the carbon footprint of raw material extraction and end-of-life recyclability.
decisions.recommendation: Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) Polycarbonate (PC) with internal ribbing
decisions.rationale: PCR-PC significantly reduces the carbon footprint compared to virgin plastics while retaining sufficient mechanical properties and impact resistance required for hand tools when optimized with structural ribbing, ensuring both durability and low embodied carbon.
decisions.design_action: Verify the supply chain availability and mechanical property consistency of high-quality PCR-PC resins, and check local recycling infrastructure compatibility for the selected polymer grade.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with machine screws
decisions.trade_off: Ease of high-speed manufacturing and structural rigidity versus non-destructive disassembly for repair and end-of-life material separation.
decisions.recommendation: Threaded metal inserts with machine screws
decisions.rationale: While snap-fits can wear out or break during disassembly and ultrasonic welding permanently seals the unit, threaded fasteners allow for infinite non-destructive disassembly cycles, enabling easy battery and motor replacement, which vastly extends the product's useful life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate standardizing fastener sizes across the entire assembly to ensure disassembly can be performed with a single common tool type, and check the compatibility of insert materials with recycling processes.

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium (rare-earth) magnets
decisions.trade_off: High energy efficiency and long operational lifespan (brushless) versus the high environmental and ethical impacts of mining rare-earth elements (neodymium magnets) and higher initial carbon footprint.
decisions.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium (rare-earth) magnets
decisions.rationale: The BLDC motor offers significantly higher energy efficiency (reducing battery drain and thermal stress) and eliminates brush wear, which is a primary failure mode in power tools. The extended product life and reduced battery wear outweigh the initial environmental footprint of the rare-earth magnets.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the feasibility of sourcing neodymium magnets with certified recycled content or from suppliers with audited ethical mining practices, and verify end-of-life magnet recovery pathways.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan integrated on the motor shaft
Passive cooling via aluminum heatsink and ventilation slots
Phase Change Material (PCM) heat sink encapsulation
decisions.trade_off: Effective heat dissipation to protect battery and motor life versus increased part complexity, dust ingress risks, and material mix complexity.
decisions.recommendation: Passive cooling via aluminum heatsink and ventilation slots
decisions.rationale: Passive cooling avoids the energy draw and mechanical wear of an active fan while maintaining a simpler, more reliable design. Using a recyclable aluminum heatsink avoids the complex material mixtures of PCMs, facilitating easier end-of-life recycling while protecting critical components from thermal degradation.
decisions.design_action: Verify the spatial constraints within the housing to ensure sufficient natural convection airflow, and check that ventilation slot geometry prevents dust ingress without restricting airflow.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge system (separate battery, motor/gearbox, and control modules)
Semi-modular layout with soldered wire connections
decisions.trade_off: Compactness and lower initial assembly cost versus ease of maintenance, component salvageability, and user-level repairability.
decisions.recommendation: Modular cartridge system (separate battery, motor/gearbox, and control modules)
decisions.rationale: A modular cartridge system allows users or technicians to easily swap out a degraded battery pack or a worn-out gearbox without discarding the entire tool. It also simplifies end-of-life sorting and recycling of electronics, metals, and plastics.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the use of plug-and-play board-to-board or wire harness connectors instead of soldered joints to verify that module swapping can be done without specialized tools.

decisions.trade_off: High energy density and compact form factor versus battery degradation over time, ease of replacement, and the environmental impact of lithium extraction.
decisions.rationale: Standardized cylindrical cells (like 18650s) have established recycling pathways and are easily replaceable. Making the pack removable ensures the tool is not rendered obsolete when the battery degrades, which is the most common cause of cordless tool disposal.
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability of standardized, safety-certified 18650 battery packs from suppliers with robust take-back or recycling programs, and check compliance with international transport and safety regulations for removable batteries.
